topics.title: Students will demonstrate proficiency in motor skills and movement patterns needed to perform a variety of activities

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate proficiency in motor skills and movement patterns needed to perform a variety of activities

outcomes.text: I can demonstrate emerging locomotor and non-locomotor skills, movement patterns, and basic manipulative skills with beginning weight transfer and travel.
I can distinguish the differences between locomotor, nonlocomotor, and manipulative skills.
I can execute mature patterns of locomotor and non-locomotor skills, and patterns utilizing different pathways, speed, and levels.
I can perform basic manipulative skills in a mature pattern.

topics.title: Students will apply the knowledge of concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics related to movement and performance

subtopics.title: Students will apply the knowledge of concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics related to movement and performance

outcomes.text: I can differentiate my personal space from the personal space of others in general space when I use locomotor and non-locomotor skills.
I can use locomotor skills to travel different pathways, at varying levels and different speeds.
I can combine locomotor skills, pathways, levels, direction, and speed in general space with rhythm.
I can demonstrate emerging understanding of chasing and fleeing activities.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy needed to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical activity

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy needed to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical activity

outcomes.text: I can identify active play opportunities outside of physical education.
I can recognize that my heart rate and breathing speed up as I move harder and faster.
I can discuss the benefits of being active through play and/or exercise.
I can identify the heart as a muscle that grows stronger with exercise, play, and other physical activity.

topics.title: Students will exhibit responsible personal and social behavior that respects self and others

subtopics.title: Students will exhibit responsible personal and social behavior that respects self and others

outcomes.text: I can follow instruction and directions for myself and/or my group when prompted.
I can share equipment and space with others.
I can accept specific corrective feedback and responsibility for class protocols.
I can work safely and responsibly in physical education class.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy through physical activity for health, enjoyment, challenge, self-expression, and/or social interaction

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy through physical activity for health, enjoyment, challenge, self-expression, and/or social interaction

outcomes.text: I can recognize that physical activities can be enjoyed individually or with others.
I can recognize that some physical activities will be challenging, but can be enjoyable.
I can explain how cooperating with others can lead to success.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate proficiency in motor skills and movement patterns needed to perform a variety of activities

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate proficiency in motor skills and movement patterns needed to perform a variety of activities

outcomes.text: I can combine various locomotor and non-locomotor skills and manipulative skills within activities (small-sided activities and for skills requiring accuracy to a target).
I can demonstrate emerging patterns of passing with the hands and feet, volleying, and striking with implements.
I can determine force, distance, and height needed for accuracy with basic manipulative skills.
I can combine traveling with manipulative skills in a mature pattern.

topics.title: Students will apply the knowledge of concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics related to movement and performance

subtopics.title: Students will apply the knowledge of concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics related to movement and performance

outcomes.text: I can recognize spatial needs, pathways, directions, and speed as instructed by the teacher (movement concepts).
I can determine my path and speed for running and fleeing activities.
I can apply spatial and movement concepts for strategy in games and activities.
I can analyze game/activity situations for needed movement concepts.
I can apply basic offensive and defensive strategies and tactics in various games and activities.
I can recognize the type of manipulative skills needed for different games and activities.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy needed to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical activity

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy needed to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical activity

outcomes.text: I can describe the concept of fitness and provide examples of how physical activity enhances health.
I can differentiate between skill-related and health-related fitness.

topics.title: Students will exhibit responsible personal and social behavior that respects self and others

subtopics.title: Students will exhibit responsible personal and social behavior that respects self and others

outcomes.text: I can work cooperatively and praise others for their successes.
I can accept players of all skill levels in various physical activities.
I can engage in physical activities with responsible interpersonal behavior.
I can apply safety principles.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy through physical activity for health, enjoyment, challenge, self-expression, and/or social interaction

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy through physical activity for health, enjoyment, challenge, self-expression, and/or social interaction

outcomes.text: I can discuss how practice develops confidence when working on challenging physical activity.
I can describe how the benefits of physical activity at school can be replicated in other settings.
I can explain how cooperating with others can lead to success.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate proficiency in motor skills and movement patterns needed to perform a variety of activities

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate proficiency in motor skills and movement patterns needed to perform a variety of activities

outcomes.text: I can apply locomotor, non-locomotor, and manipulative skills to games and sports with an emphasis on executing the skills with correct fundamental technique.
I can integrate change of direction and speed while maintaining control of the body and manipulative.
I can differentiate offensive and defensive skills for various games and sports.
I can identify various games and sports and the skills needed for each.
I can execute the skills required for a variety of games and sports.
I can demonstrate correct technique for basic skills in at least two outdoor recreation activities.

topics.title: Students will apply the knowledge of concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics related to movement and performance

subtopics.title: Students will apply the knowledge of concepts, principles, strategies, and tactics related to movement and performance

outcomes.text: I can judge when I need to transition between offense and defense, minimizing options for opponents, and correcting defensive play based on the situation.
I can implement varying force and direction for games and activities.
I can recognize the strategic relationship between open spaces and manipulative skills.
I can communicate to advance a partner/teammate or to capitalize on an advantage during transitions between offense and defense and/ or reduce open spaces.
I can describe and apply mechanical advantages to vary force or direction in the game/activity situation.
I can evaluate the weather and other situations to make adjustments regarding safety during outdoor recreation activities.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy needed to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical activity

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy needed to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical activity (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: I can describe how being physically active leads to a healthy body.
I can analyze the difference between aerobic and non-aerobic exercise and the difference between muscular strength and endurance.
I can describe the relationship between resting heart rate and aerobic fitness.
I can recognize factors that influence personal physical activity.

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy needed to achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of physical activity (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: I can use technology to enhance the benefits of exercise.
I can create and implement a personal workout plan using the overload principle, or FITT formula, to improve levels of health-related fitness and nutrition.
I can apply strategies for dealing with stress, such as deep breathing, guided visualization, and aerobic exercise.

topics.title: Students will exhibit responsible personal and social behavior that respects self and others

subtopics.title: Students will exhibit responsible personal and social behavior that respects self and others

outcomes.text: I can demonstrate personal responsibility for collaboration and safe behaviors.
I can provide encouragement and positive feedback to those with differences in physical development, maturation, and skill level.
I can use rules and guidelines for addressing ethical and unethical behavior during physical activity.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy through physical activity for health, enjoyment, challenge, self-expression, and/or social interaction

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate physical literacy through physical activity for health, enjoyment, challenge, self-expression, and/or social interaction

outcomes.text: I can discuss how lifelong physical activity benefits physical, social, and emotional health.
I can apply the five components of health-related fitness and explain the connections between fitness and overall mental and physical health.
I can ask for help and help others in various physical activities.
